title: Speciation and Kinetics of Cation Stabilized-Anthraquinone Films for Electrochemically Mediated CO 2 Capture

compounds.name: anthraquinone
compounds.quote: the electrochemical behavior and speciation of a tethered AQ film in an aprotic organic solvent under inert gas (argon) conditions are first determined.

conditions.quote: The dotted line in Figure 1a shows the cyclic voltammogram of the grafted AQ film in 0.1 M TBABF4 (acetonitrile) electrolyte
